about: Common Nigerian merchants, billers, wallets, lenders and savings apps, matched before any AI runs. Aliases are lowercase words matched whole against the narration (punctuation ignored; multi-word aliases also match when the bank ran the words together). Labels use the app taxonomy (src/core/taxonomy.ts). Kinds: wallet entries only label a debit that names nobody else (funding your own wallet); lender debits are repayments and credits are loan proceeds; savings entries are own transfers both ways.
